neighbours.label: In code (Python, JavaScript and similar), a list literal assigned to a name (x = [...] or key=[...]) whose FIRST item is the constant None, null, nil, True or False: it lights up on that first constant. A dict or object as the first list item also fires. The same constant later in a list is in between (weaker); the same constant outside any list (a bare assignment, a dict value, a function argument, a tuple) stays quiet.
neighbours.short: None/null/True/False as the first item of an assigned code list
fire: local stack = {nil, 1, 2}  -- wait, in Ruby: stack = [nil, 1, 2]
